Class AbstractHtmlInputElementTag

org.springframework.web.servlet.tags.form.AbstractHtmlInputElementTag
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.DynamicAttributes, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.IterationTag, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.JspTag, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.Tag, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.TryCatchFinally, Serializable, EditorAwareTag
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractCheckedElementTag, InputTag, SelectTag, TextareaTag
public abstract class AbstractHtmlInputElementTag extends AbstractHtmlElementTag
Base class for databinding-aware JSP tags that render HTML form input element.

提供一组属性，对应于表单输入元素中通用的 HTML 属性集。

Since:
2.0
Author:
Rob Harrop, Rick Evans, Juergen Hoeller
